info.name: Spot On : Go See Mr. Spot

descriptions.notStarted: Mr. Spot is in Kerning City, and he has something that could help Mom and Dad. I'd better go see my parents first before I visit him.
descriptions.inProgress: I visited Mr. Spot and got the Mouse for Mom and Dad. I can get a #bNexon Prepaid#k from Mr. Spot if I ask them for #bAllowance#k. I'll cross my fingers...
descriptions.completed: I got my #bNexon Prepaid#k! I should keep it, because it will turn into Maple Points soon! SWEET!
